g.text: Per-instance refs: Slot1 = U6 / SW2 / Q1 / D4 / R62 / R29 / C22 / C23.

g.desc: Per-instance refs: Slot1 = U6 / SW2 / Q1 / D4 / R62 / R29 / C22 / C23.

g.text: VSUPPLY_1..12 and GND1..12 remain the mating sockets.

g.desc: VSUPPLY_1..12 and GND1..12 remain the mating sockets.

g.text: J7..J18 shunt jumpers were replaced by SW2..SW13.

g.desc: J7..J18 shunt jumpers were replaced by SW2..SW13.

g.text: 5V position: SW pin 2 connects to pin 3 (VBUS_PROT); SEL high selects 5V_SYS.

g.desc: 5V position: SW pin 2 connects to pin 3 (VBUS_PROT); SEL high selects 5V_SYS.

g.text: pulls SEL low and selects +3.3V. Q drives the LED without loading SEL.

g.desc: pulls SEL low and selects +3.3V. Q drives the LED without loading SEL.

g.text: The LED supply is 5V_SYS. RESET pulls the 3.3V rail low, not SEL or MODE;

g.desc: The LED supply is 5V_SYS. RESET pulls the 3.3V rail low, not SEL or MODE;

g.text: a 3V3-selected slot is not switched to 5V by pressing RESET.
